matches.source:
syntax = "proto2";

option (a) = { test:<foo:"m&m" array:1 array:2 s:<name:"yolo" id:98765>> fff:OK };
message M { optional string a = 1 [deprecated = true]; }
message M { message N { bool b = 1; } }
message M { enum E { A = 0; B = 1 [(x) = 2]; } }
message M { oneof o { string a = 1; int32 b = 2; } }
message M { reserved 1, 2 to 5, 9 to max; reserved "a", "b"; }
enum E { A = 0; B = -1; option allow_alias = true; }
service S { rpc F (stream Req) returns (stream Res) { option (x) = 1; } }
message M { required group G = 1 { optional int32 a = 2; } }

rejections.source: service S { rpc F (A) returns B; }
